role: The chest (and its trapped variant): a container block that pairs into double chests, faces its neighbours, opens a 27-slot window on use, and spills its contents when broken.

members.name: field_149955_b
members.note: One Random per Block singleton (chest, trapped chest: block_rand[BR_CHEST], [BR_TRAPPED_CHEST]); Snapshot writes both states and a cached Gaussian into det.nbt's chest list (BlockRands.java), serverreplay_load sets them, a --from run restores them from the checkpoint's pre/det.nbt, and the born states are the default. The dig probe still hands its own state over (dig_env.chest).
